description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS`, which is responsible for validating CSS style attributes within HTML elements for the HTMLPurifier project. It implements logic to parse, validate, and sanitize inline CSS declarations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS
classes.description: Class responsible for validating CSS style attributes in HTML elements within the HTMLPurifier sanitization library.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS style string, parsing declarations, checking property validity against the CSS definition, and sanitizing values. Returns the cleaned declarations string or false if invalid.
